tasks.title: Audit search visibility and content
tasks.instructions: Audit SEO and AI-search visibility, site structure, content plans and link opportunities from the data you were given. Every finding has a source and a date. Missing data is marked MISSING, never estimated. Attach as 01-search.md.

tasks.title: Audit conversion and write copy changes
tasks.instructions: Audit pages, forms, sign-up flows and popups, and write the copy changes that would convert better, each with its evidence. Attach as 02-conversion.md.

tasks.title: Review paid campaigns and creative
tasks.instructions: Review the paid campaigns and creative: what to keep, cut or test, with the reason taken from the numbers. Attach as 03-paid.md.

tasks.title: Review lifecycle, churn and pricing
tasks.instructions: Review the email and onboarding sequences, churn and referral programmes, and pricing as a lifecycle lever, each with its evidence. Attach as 04-lifecycle.md.

tasks.title: Design the measurement and experiments
tasks.instructions: Design the measurement and the experiments: hypothesis, metric, sample size and stop rule for each. The runtime has no analytics connection; say so when a conclusion needs one. Attach as 05-measure.md.

tasks.title: Check every recommendation and figure
tasks.instructions: Recompute every figure and check every claim against its source. A FAIL names the claim and what is wrong. Writes no recommendations of its own. Attach your verdict as 06-check.md.
